subject: Pricing staircase + invoicing flow — next steps
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Huang <sarah.huang@novaprosper.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pricing staircase + invoicing flow — next steps

Sarah,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Attached is our redlined Order Form (v2) that implements the pricing staircase we discussed and the proposed min-commit phasing. Highlights:

- Pricing tiers: Month 1-3 at $X / unit (trial rate), Month 4+ at agreed standard rate; see table on p2.
- Minimum commit: $250k annualized, with a two-tranche acceptance (50% upfront, 50% after 6 months) — draft language in §3.
- Net terms: default Net 30; we noted your ask for Net 45 below.
- Invoicing: Redwood invoices monthly; we can route to your AR contact and include PO numbers per invoice.
- Taxes: We left the tax clause standard and added a checkbox for customer VAT responsibilities; please confirm if NovaProsper requires reverse-charge handling.

Action items for you:
1) Confirm Net 30 vs Net 45 — if Net 45, we'll need to update payment ops (possible fee).
2) Confirm whether NovaProsper will provide VAT registration / reverse-charge certificates.
3) If the payment schedule is acceptable, I'll push to Legal (cc'd) to finalize redlines and generate DocuSign.

Attachment: Redlined_OrderForm_v2.pdf (PDF, 1 page summary + redlines)

Thanks,

Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
viv.kulkarni@redwood.ai

From: Sarah Huang <sarah.huang@novaprosper.com>

Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing staircase + invoicing flow — next steps

Vivek —

Thanks for the summary and the redlines. A few quick notes:

- Net terms: we typically require Net 30. Net 45 will be a tough sell for Finance.
- Taxes: NovaProsper is VAT-registered in the UK; we can provide VAT registration and reverse-charge evidence for EU transactions. For US invoicing, we expect no withholding.
- Minimum commit phasing: We prefer a 25/25/50 split across quarters rather than 50/50.

We can review internally and get back by EOD Wednesday. If Legal needs to see tracked redlines, please route.

--
Sarah Huang
VP Finance
NovaProsper Inc.
sarah.huang@novaprosper.com

Subject: Re: Pricing staircase + invoicing flow — next steps

Sarah,

Appreciate the quick reply and the preference for Net 30 — that's aligned. Two clarifications from our side:

- Pricing tiers: the staircase is intended to give you ramp protection; the 25/25/50 commit split should be acceptable. I'll update the schedule (attached spreadsheet) and mark the billing points.
- Invoicing: we can accept PO numbers per invoice. Please confirm the AR contact and preferred invoice email address (AP@novaprosper.com?).
- Tax evidence: please upload VAT certs and any reverse-charge docs to the secure link below so Finance can validate before we issue the first invoice.

Attachment: payment_schedule.xlsx (XLSX)
Link: https://drive.redwood.ai/s/secure-upload/novaprosper-vat

Kimberly — can Legal review the updated split and confirm any backend billing language we should add (PO acceptance window, invoice dispute SLA)?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Sales Operations

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>

Cc: Sarah Huang <sarah.huang@novaprosper.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing staircase + invoicing flow — next steps

Team / Sarah,

Reviewed the redlines and the proposed 25/25/50 split. A few legal/ops asks before we finalize:

1) Invoicing routing — please confirm whether NovaProsper requires invoices to be issued to a legal entity different than the commercial party. If so include entity name and remittance address; we'll add an invoice-entity appendix.
2) PO acceptance: we propose a 10-business-day PO acceptance clause; if we don't receive PO within that window Redwood will proceed with invoice issuance and assume commercial acceptance.
3) Taxes: we'll keep the tax clause as 'customer responsible for VAT' and add language for reverse-charge where customer supplies valid documentation. For US-sourced services, we will not gross-up unless there's a statutory withholding obligation.
4) Net terms: Net 30 accepted. If NovaProsper later requests Net 45, list it as an exception in the CFO approval appendix (billing ops may require a fee).

I've attached a tracked version of the MSA + Order Form with the invoice appendix and the PO acceptance language. If the external legal team is comfortable, we can prepare DocuSign envelope tomorrow using the HubSpot deal DP-1892.

Attachment: Redlines_MSA_OrderForm_trackchanges.docx (DOCX)
Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/DP-1892

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference
